title: Weekly Regulation Monitoring Report
executive_summary: Report period 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-16: 2 EU policy items tracked. No HIGH or MEDIUM risk changes. One LOW-risk European Commission item on child safety online may affect Browser/HbbTV, Voice assistant, AI features, Network services, Cybersecurity controls, OTA, and Remote control/voice input. One general EU portal item has no immediate actions. Compliance teams should review the EC report, complete child-safety gap assessments and DPIA updates, harden defaults for child profiles, prepare an OTA plan, and continue monitoring for follow-up actions.

key_changes.title: European Commission
key_changes.summary: Special panel report and recommendations on child safety online with potential implications for Smart TV apps, voice features, and connected services used by minors.
recommended_actions: Obtain and review the EC special panel report and recommendations on child safety online
Gap-assess parental controls, content filtering, safe search, and age-gating in Browser/HbbTV apps
Review data collection, profiling, and advertising practices for minors; disable by default where applicable
Conduct/refresh a child-focused DPIA for voice assistant, AI features, and network services
Harden default privacy and safety settings for child profiles and guest modes
Prepare an OTA plan to deploy child-safety improvements and updated consent flows
Set up monitoring for any EC follow-up or legislative proposals stemming from the report
